item.title: AI Podcasters Really Want to Tell You How to Keep a Man Happy
item.description: Videos of fake relationship guru podcasters are reinforcing gender tropes and racking up millions of views, all the while driving sales to AI influencer schools.

item.title: Meta’s New AI Asked for My Raw Health Data—and Gave Me Terrible Advice
item.description: Meta’s Muse Spark model offers to analyze users’ health data, including lab results. Beyond the obvious privacy risks, it’s not a capable stand-in for a real doctor.

item.title: OpenAI Backs Bill That Would Limit Liability for AI-Enabled Mass Deaths or Financial Disasters
item.description: The ChatGPT-maker testified in favor of an Illinois bill that would limit when AI labs can be held liable—even in cases where their products cause “critical harm.”

item.title: The 70-Person AI Image Startup Taking on Silicon Valley's Giants
item.description: Black Forest Labs has long punched above its weight in the AI image generation space. Its next move? Powering physical AI.

item.title: The Pro-Iran Meme Machine Trolling Trump With AI Lego Cartoons
item.description: Since the beginning of the Iran war, the group Explosive Media has released over a dozen viral videos mocking Trump and the US.

item.title: This AI Wearable From Ex-Apple Engineers Looks Like an iPod Shuffle
item.description: Two former Apple Vision Pro developers made an AI wearable that only listens when you tap it. They hope to win where other AI gadgets have fumbled: privacy.

item.title: Anthropic vs. the Pentagon: This Time, a US Court Has Ruled in the Government's Favor
item.description: A US appeals court ruling is at odds with a separate, lower court decision from March, leaving uncertainty about if and how the US military can use the AI company's Claude model.

item.title: Meta’s New AI Model Gives Mark Zuckerberg a Seat at the Big Kid’s Table
item.description: Muse Spark is Meta’s first model since its AI reboot, and the benchmarks suggest formidable performance.

item.title: The US Army Is Building Its Own Chatbot for Combat
item.description: The AI system, trained on real military data, is meant to give soldiers mission-critical information.

item.title: 5 Burning Questions About Elon Musk’s Terafab Chip Partnership with Intel
item.description: Intel’s role in Elon Musk’s ambitious chip venture is still murky, raising questions about what the partnership actually entails—and whether it can work at all.
